tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Search DexSheet's dataset of crypto trading venues by free text (matches name, slug, summary and best_for) with optional filters for category, chain and US availability. Returns brief records with DexSheet page URL and open_url.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Return the full DexSheet record for one venue: fees (components, tiers, perps, round trip), referral terms, custody, KYC, geo availability, status, source URLs and check date, plus the DexSheet page URL and open_url.

tools.name: compare_fees
tools.description: Compute the platform-fee cost in USD of a buy plus sell round trip at a given trade size for spot-comparable venues (terminal, telegram-bot, launchpad, wallet, exchange, aggregator with a published round trip), sorted cheapest first. Network/gas fees, pool/LP fees and slippage are excluded. For perp

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every venue category in the dataset with the number of venues in each.
